newsitem.title: MONGOLIA: Mongolia unemployment rises 14.19 pct from Jan-May.
newsitem.headline: Mongolia unemployment rises 14.19 pct from Jan-May.

text.p: Unemployment in Mongolia rose 14.19 percent in the first five months of 1997, from 55,405 to 63,271, the State Statistical Bulletin said on Wednesday.
It was up 28.76 percent from May 1996, the bulletin said.
The number of unemployed includes only those registered with local employment offices.
"There are a large number of unregistered unemployed persons. Therefore data on unemployment is less than the actual situation," the Statistical Bulletin said.
State statistics for 1996 said the number of able-bodied people of working age was 1,086,700, of whom 791,800 were employed.
